The L2 user-scenario candidates derived from the [L1 recommendations](l1-recommendations.html),
one per statement, by smart-base's `l1-recommendation-scenarios`
(`npm run l1-scenarios:uganda`). They are **candidates**: an agent wrote them, and a
person reviews each before it becomes an L2 scenario.

*Generated by `scripts/gen-l1-pages.mjs`; do not edit.*

| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.A03 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give measles-rubella subcutaneously in the left upper arm so that each dose is given by the correct route at the correct site. | [A03](l1-recommendations.html): Measles-Rubella (Subcutaneous) to the baby's left upper arm |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.A04 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give IPV and PCV intramuscularly in the right thigh, 2 cm apart so that each dose is given by the correct route at the correct site. | [A04](l1-recommendations.html): IPV (2cm apart) (Intramuscular) and PCV (2cm apart) (Intramuscular) to the baby's right thigh |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.A05 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give the hepatitis B birth dose and DTP-HepB-Hib intramuscularly in the left thigh so that each dose is given by the correct route at the correct site. | [A05](l1-recommendations.html): Hep B Birth dose (Intramuscular) and DPT-HepB-Hib (Intramuscular) to the baby's left thigh |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C01 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give the hepatitis B birth dose as soon as possible after birth, ideally within 24 hours and up to 7 days so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C01](l1-recommendations.html): Hep B BD: As soon as possible after birth, ideally within 24 hours and up to 7 days |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C02 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give BCG as soon as possible after birth so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C02](l1-recommendations.html): BCG: As soon as possible after birth |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C03 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give the 6-week doses at 6 weeks or as soon as possible after so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C03](l1-recommendations.html): At 6 weeks (or as soon as possible thereafter) |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C04 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give the 10-week doses at 10 weeks or as soon as possible after, at least 4 weeks after dose 1 so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C04](l1-recommendations.html): At 10 weeks (or as soon as possible thereafter), and at least 4 weeks after dose 1 |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C05 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give the 14-week doses at 14 weeks or as soon as possible after, at least 4 weeks after dose 2 so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C05](l1-recommendations.html): At 14 weeks (or as soon as possible thereafter), and at least 4 weeks after dose 2 |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C06 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give MR1 and yellow fever at 9 months or as soon as possible after so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C06](l1-recommendations.html): At 9 months (or as soon as possible thereafter) |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C07 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I give MR2 at 18 months or as soon as possible after, at least 4 weeks after the previous dose so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C07](l1-recommendations.html): At 18 months (or as soon as possible there after), and at least 4 weeks since the previous dose |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C08 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I not give the hepatitis B birth dose after 7 days of age so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C08](l1-recommendations.html): Hep B BD: Not after 7 days |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C09 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I not give rotavirus dose 1 after 2 years of age so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C09](l1-recommendations.html): RV1: Not after 2 years of age |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C10 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I not give a 10-week dose within 4 weeks of the previous dose, nor rotavirus dose 2 after 2 years so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C10](l1-recommendations.html): Not before 4 weeks has passed since the previous dose, RV2: Not after 2 years of age |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C11 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I not give a 14-week dose within 4 weeks of the previous dose, nor rotavirus dose 3 after 2 years so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C11](l1-recommendations.html): Not before 4 weeks has passed since the previous dose, RV3: Not after 2 years of age |
| IMMZ.UG.UNEPI.C12 | As a Health worker (HW), during IMMZ.D Administer vaccine, I not give MR1 or yellow fever before 9 months of age, except where indicated so that every child who is behind is brought up to date without invalid or unsafe doses. | [C12](l1-recommendations.html): Not before 9 months of age (except where indicated)* |
